info.title: WHP Standing — Sovereign Epistemological Evaluator & x402 Pre-Settlement Gate
info.description: Sovereign epistemological evaluator (not a passive notary). There is one evaluation door (/v1/evaluate), one service all the way through. When a client or autonomous agent inserts their data through the door, a sovereign Large Language Model waiting inside the door — having been given Decision Integrity Version 7 (The Continuous Work) — adopts the reasoning from the text and applies that epistemological reasoning to whatever data the client puts through the door. The evaluation is the Large Language Model applying the Decision Integrity Version 7 reasoning to that data, and the output is signed with the WHP Standing Mark (WHP-STANDING-MARK-v1) and handed back to the client. TEST is never LIVE.
